rules.reason: If ground truth is forced past the 4.5 s warm-up (60 s in r06/r17/r27/r30/r32), the ego replays the recording for the whole run and the policy is never evaluated.

The kinematic_ideal controller (r03/r12/r28/r31/r33) produces accelerations a car cannot reach (6.6–16.2 m/s²) and replaces the MPC tracking the batch measures; the reference and all other runs use linear.
